description.en: Session reference projector (DRS): read-only scan of ~/.dsh/sessions logs, decoded into a private SQLite (segments/replaces/FTS5) with surface flags, recall-pair accounting and a Chinese-capable search face, served via /api/dsh-reference-session-collector. Never writes session files.
description.zh: 会话原文投影同步器（DRS）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions 会话日志，解码后投影进自有 SQLite（segments/replaces/FTS5），经 /api/dsh-reference-session-collector 提供 surface 标记、召回对账与中文可用的内容检索面。绝不写会话文件。
